Class InternalButton

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.command2.button.Trigger
org.wpilib.command2.button.InternalButton
All Implemented Interfaces:
BooleanSupplier
public class InternalButton extends Trigger
This class is intended to be used within a program. The programmer can manually set its value. Also includes a setting for whether it should invert its value.

This class is provided by the Commands v2 VendorDep
